dpSolveList_optimal

lean lemma dpSolveList_optimal (w b : I → Nat) : ∀ (items : List I), items.Nodup → ∀ capacity {x : BinaryAllocation I}, supportedOn items x → natBinaryLoad w x ≤ capacity → natBinarySocialWelfare b x ≤ natBinarySocialWelfare b (dpSolveList w b items capacity)
